notes: Only assets listed here were visually inspected during this QA pass.
Routes are recorded from the sandbox UI and filename context; no live customer data was used.
Raw full viewport captures were moved out of public marketing assets; finance-* files were intentionally not changed.
Care, scheduling, and finance candidates were visually reviewed during offline QA. Warning-heavy tracking-board variants and the black historical-basis image were excluded.
No approved asset is a generated app mockup. Feature pages must label related captures when a direct feature screen is unavailable.
Removed sparse or generic-seed invoice detail, ledger, and payment-history candidates during final QA; use the richer open invoice detail and paid invoice detail instead.
Ten sparse, clipped, warning-bearing, or weak candidates were moved to non-public capture-raw after visual review.
sourceQuality: Approved app visuals originate in the synthetic Meta Clinic sandbox. Some are cropped to omit warnings or workspace chrome; the booking visual joins crops from the same real dialog. No app controls, records, or screenshots were generated from scratch.
capturePolicy: Actual Meta Clinic app pixels only. Crops and joins of the same source screenshot are permitted and noted; fully generated app screens are excluded.
